thread:
maria: Anyone else seeing client sockets go to CLOSED without a reconnect event and the dashboard still showing active connections? Repro on prod and canary. Likely in proxy->edge close propagation.
jon: saw it once yesterday during load test. stack: websocket proxied via edge-nginx -> proxy. Does the socket emit EOF or a 0-length frame?
maria: We see a 200 with chunked body ending then connection: close. Client never gets final SSE 'done' event and our stream metrics stick. Example response headers we captured: `Connection: close`, `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`.
ashok: Possibly our close handler isn't emitting the `stream_closed` telemetry because it expects an explicit `end` event from the runtime. If the proxy terminates mid-frame we might skip emit. cc @elaine for dashboard impact.
elaine: Dashboard uses `connection_opened` / `connection_closed` events ingested by the pipeline to drive websocket_active gauge. If `connection_closed` doesn't arrive, the UI shows ghost connections. Need to verify whether the ingest pipeline drops events when upstream returns 499/504.
devops-bot: deploy 1719012380: rolled proxy tweak (reduce keepalive timeout) to canary :rocket:
samir: After the canary deploy I see fewer ghosts but still occasional ones. I captured raw tcp: edge sent FIN, proxy replied with RST ~200ms later. That RST path probably prevents the runtime from flushing the 'closed' event to the ingest stream.
jon: Can we add a reconciliation probe at ingest that compares active_gauge -> L7 connection logs every minute? Temporary alert if mismatch > 1% would catch these.
elaine: Agree. Also change dashboard UX to show "last-seen" timestamp per connection so ghosts appear as stale rather than live. I'll file a Console ticket for that change.
maria: Created ticket ENG-8342. Short-term mitigations: increase websocket keepalive on edge to 90s, enable reconnection jitter on client lib (PR ready). Long-term: ensure proxy translates FIN->graceful close and forces emission of `connection_closed` from runtime.
ashok: For telemetry we should add a `close_reason` tag (values: client_fin, proxy_rst, runtime_eof) so we can slice by cause. This will require a small schema change on the ingest side.
elaine: Schema change OK from Console side, backfill not required. I'll coordinate with infra on the pipeline change window.
samir: Important: billing uses active connection counts for per-tenant quotas. Ghosts cause customers to hit quota prematurely. We should adjust the quota calculator to prefer authoritative L7 logs for billing until telemetry is fixed.
maria: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. Who can own the canary watch tonight? @jon will you take point?
jon: Yep. I'll put together a short watch doc and a temporary Grafana panel comparing `websocket_active_gauge` vs `l7_conn_count` and add an alert. Will also tail ingest for `connection_closed` events.
elaine: I'll open the Console PR for last-seen UX and add the stale-marker visual.
ashok: I'll add the `close_reason` tag and a unit test for FIN->RST flows so we don't regress.
maria: Great. If we still see ghosts after the ingestion patch we'll open a broader rollback/traffic-redirection plan. (reaction :eyes:)
